prompt: Why are different IP addresses recommended when hosting multiple HTTPS virtual hosts? (Choose two.)
choices: Apache caches SSL keys based on the IP address
The Server Name Indication extension for TLS is not universally supported
The SSL key is linked to a specific IP address when issued by the CA
This is only needed when more than one virtual host generates dynamic content
The SSL connection is established before the virtual host name is known to the server
explanation: Without SNI (which is not universally supported), the TLS handshake completes before the requested host name is known, so each HTTPS vhost needs its own IP.
